title: Graded Word Similarity in Context
description: Rate the graded semantic similarity of a PAIR of target words that appear together within a shared context, based on SemEval-2020 Task 3 (Armendariz et al.). The same word pair is judged within two different contexts; Subtask 1 predicts the change in similarity between contexts and Subtask 2 predicts the absolute rating. Ratings follow the SimLex-style 0-6 similarity scale (later mapped to 0-10). Similarity is distinct from relatedness (e.g., coffee and cup are related but not similar).
